config.record_grain: One row per current Australian Financial Services licence register entry, containing the licence-holder register label, optional polymorphic ABN/ACN, principal business address components, and licence-register attributes.

fields.evidence: ASIC Australian Financial Services Licensee Help File p.8 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee's ABN or ACN; discovery row 2 sample is 85007186003. digits plus abn performs exact checksum validation and emits no value for a valid ACN.

ASIC Australian Financial Services Licensee Help File p.8 data dictionary explicitly defines AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN as ABN or ACN; the same mixed column is mapped independently to acn. digits plus acn performs exact checksum validation and emits no value for a valid ABN; no suffix derivation is used.
ASIC Help File p.9: AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL is the locality of the current principal business address; discovery row 2 exact sample is SOUTHBANK.
ASIC Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE is the state from the current principal business address; discovery rows 2-3 exact samples are VIC and NSW.

ASIC Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE is the postcode from the current principal business address; discovery row 2 exact sample is 3006. postcode preserves the source numeric ID as a string and does not zero-pad damaged values.

ASIC Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY is the country of the principal business address and countries outside Australia are set to International; discovery rows 2-3 exact sample is Australia. Australia is normalized to ontology default-style country code AU; International is retained as the publisher's documented non-country sentinel because no specific country is supplied.

unmapped_fields.reason: Help File p.8 describes this as the name of the register the record belongs to; the ontology has no register-name field, and it is not evidence of a legal name or entity type.

Help File p.8 describes this as the unique identifier allocated to the Australian Financial Services licensee; the ontology has no licence-number field, so it must not be misused as an entity identifier.

Help File p.8 calls this the register entry name and documents person and organisation formatting. The source does not establish legal-name or trading-name status, so the raw label is retained only via subject_label_field and is not mapped to either canonical name field.

Help File p.8 defines this as the AFS licensee/licence start date. It is not company registration, charity registration, trading-name registration, or legal-entity registration, so it is not mapped to entity.date_registered.
Help File p.9 defines this as previous superseded-register identifiers and licence numbers, with nested tilde/comma-delimited content. The ontology has no licence-history field.

Help File p.11 defines this as current financial-services authorisations and limitations, using nested tilde/comma-delimited text. The ontology has no licence-condition or authorisation field; it does not establish industry code, legal name, entity type, or entity status.

limitations: The source is a weekly point-in-time snapshot of current Australian Financial Services licensees, as stated in the ASIC Help File p.3; inclusion as a current licensee is not mapped to entity.status=active, and licence revocation or change would not prove legal-entity deregistration.

AFS_LIC_NAME is retained as a raw subject identity label, not asserted to be a legal name, trading name, branch, or reporting-group name. The source does not establish that every licence holder is a legal entity.
AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is polymorphic. ABN and ACN are independently checksum-validated from the same column; valid identifiers of the other type emit no value, and no ACN is inferred from an ABN suffix.

The source supplies principal business address locality, state, postcode, and country only. These are not asserted to be a registered office, branch, service location, or full street address; address.full is therefore unmapped.

The publisher's International country value is a sentinel rather than a specific country. Australia is normalized to AU, while International is deliberately retained as the documented sentinel and requires human review for downstream country semantics.
The source provides no canonical legal-entity type, legal registration date, or legal-entity status; entity.entity_type, entity.date_registered, and entity.status remain unmapped.

The mapping declaration cannot target the required observation-envelope fields. The ingestion engine must supply source_id, deterministic source_record_id traceable to snapshot_sha plus CSV row, ingested_at, licence, and extractor_version; observed_at must use the supplied publication timestamp 2026-09-16T21:52:45.982310 as a publication proxy, with its basis and timezone explicitly recorded. Missing envelope values must be quarantined.
No row filter is encoded: the Help File p.3 states the downloadable dataset contains current licensees, so current scope is a source-level statement rather than an inferred entity-status filter.
All authority and field-confidence scores are provisional uncalibrated judgements and require human review; validation passing is parse/type evidence, not semantic ground truth or link precision.

The supplied discovery exploration script failed because records was undefined. Mapping evidence relies on the supplied documentation, discovery samples, and the separate 250-row validation feedback; alternate formats and unobserved edge cases remain subject to review.
